snippet.title: All Hell Unleashed (NES) Fan Game Commercial / Trailer
snippet.description:
A twisted cult has summoned the most feared icons of horror of all time...
Now, it's up to YOU to fight against the darkness!

Download for FREE now!

👁️‍🗨️ https://8bitslasher.itch.io/ahu 👁️‍🗨️

Game by Steve of Fista Productions
NES OST Transcription & Development Assistance by Kevin81
Lead Pixel Art by Lilith Brendan
Horror Icon Label Artwork by Tollbooth10
Commercial Voiceover by Andy Colón
